title: Machine Learning Intern
description:
We are looking for a Machine Learning Intern to join our data science team. You will build and evaluate machine learning models, clean and analyse datasets, and present insights to stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and evaluate models using Python, scikit-learn, and Pandas.
- Perform feature engineering and exploratory data analysis with NumPy and Matplotlib.
- Write SQL queries to extract data from PostgreSQL databases.
- Collaborate using Git and GitHub, and write unit tests with pytest.

Requirements:
- Strong Python programming skills and knowledge of statistics.
- Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus.
- Good communication skills and a willingness to learn.

title: Junior Python Backend Developer
description:
Contoso Cloud Labs is hiring a Junior Python Backend Developer to help build scalable web services.

Responsibilities:
- Design and implement REST APIs using Flask or FastAPI.
- Work with MySQL and MongoDB databases.
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy them to AWS.
- Set up CI/CD pipelines and practise version control with Git.
- Follow Agile practices and write unit tests.

Requirements:
- Solid understanding of Python, object-oriented programming, and data structures and algorithms.
- Experience with Linux and the command line.
- Knowledge of microservices is a bonus.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Fabrikam Retail Insights needs a Data Analyst to turn sales data into clear business decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Analyse large datasets using SQL, Python, and Pandas.
- Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau and create data visualization reports.
- Use Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting.
- Apply statistical analysis to identify trends and present findings to non-technical audiences.

Requirements:
- Strong SQL and Excel skills.
- Experience with data analysis and storytelling with data.
- Bonus: knowledge of Apache Spark or Airflow.

title: AI Engineer (NLP & LLMs)
description:
Adventure Works AI is looking for an AI Engineer to build natural language processing products.

Responsibilities:
- Build NLP pipelines and fine-tune transformer models with PyTorch and Hugging Face.
- Integrate large language models (LLMs) into production applications.
- Deploy models as FastAPI services using Docker and Kubernetes, following MLOps best practices.
- Work with GCP or Azure cloud services.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in Python and deep learning.
- Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and artificial intelligence concepts.
- Experience with Git and Linux.
